headline: Site walk to examine existing conditions for a proposed 13 Lot subdivision of Tax Map 11092, Lot 001.
summary: The walk is an on-site look at the property as it is now. It covers the land tied to the proposed subdivision.
items: Examine existing conditions for the proposed 13 Lot subdivision of Tax Map 11092, Lot 001
plain_text:
"Derry, New Hampshire's Place to Be" 
14 Manning Street, Derry, New Hampshire 03038 ▪ p.603.432.6100  f.603.432.6131 
 
 
NOTICE OF SITE WALK 
 
The Conservation Commission for the Town of Derry will hold a site walk on Monday, 
November 16, 2026, beginning at 2:00pm at 45 Scenic Drive. The purpose of this site walk is to 
examine existing conditions relative to the proposed 13 Lot subdivision of Tax Map 11092, Lot 
001. 
 
POSTED: November 5, 2026
